name: AD user identity
packageArguments: Base64-encoded UTF-8 JSON object, run on a domain controller. {"Identity":"jdoe","UserPrincipalName":"jdoe@example.com","Mail":"jdoe@example.com","ProxyAddresses":"SMTP:jdoe@example.com;smtp:j.doe@example.com","TargetOu":"OU=Unsynced,DC=example,DC=com"} (Mode Plan, the default) prints the current and planned values, every other AD object holding a planned address or sAMAccountName, and the objectGUID base64 (ImmutableId), and changes nothing. Add "Mode":"Apply" to write: it refuses on a conflict or a missing OU, backs up to %ProgramData%\Relian\ad-user-identity\<sam>-<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>.json, sets only the given attributes, moves the user and reads it back. {"Identity":"jdoe","Mode":"Rollback"} restores the newest backup (or "Backup":"<file name>"). Optional: GivenName, Surname, DisplayName, NewSamAccountName. Non-SMTP proxyAddresses are kept. Never touches the password, groups or enabled state, never deletes.
